name: Admin Project Inline Create Assign Offer
description: The gap the Vastago case exposed: a project created inline from an accounting form picker (crear al vuelo) used to discard the annotated create response, so the operator was never told the client had older records without a project. Now the created event carries the unlinked_* counters and, when the form closes (saved OR cancelled - the project is a record of its own), the PA-51 assign modal opens with the server-fresh backlog; confirming assigns the checked ids and the response rows (cascaded liquid children included) fill the Proyecto cells of the open table without any reload.
